selection_rule: All three prior A8.1 first-null/RPE-sign-disagreement checkpoints; no new outcome selection.

candidate.name: first-action centered motor participation
candidate.action_record: first DOWN associated with current visible note; immutable through note resolution
candidate.eligibility: existing selected-edge eligibility sampled at first DOWN
candidate.motor_participation: per-motor spike count in existing 20,000-us readout window at first DOWN
candidate.utility: first null/early MISS=-1; first valid hit=unchanged centered game utility; no DOWN=-1 with zero update
candidate.rpe: first-action utility minus predictor expected utility sampled at first DOWN (or expiry for no DOWN)
candidate.update: at note resolution, once per note, raw=existing_eta * z_ij * first-action_RPE; clip each selected weight to existing [0,2] mV bounds; later scored DOWN never substitutes
candidate.predictor: commit first-action utility once at note resolution, including no-DOWN expiry; later scored result cannot replace it

matched_state_protocol: Candidate action tags are replayed on exact historical trajectory. At each exact pre-legacy-dopamine checkpoint, transplant the locked candidate weight vector only. Keep every nonweight field identical for all branches; freeze plasticity/exploration on the existing disjoint 32-note panel. This is a local vector gate, not a full candidate-rule rollout.

prediction.direction_at_each_checkpoint: later first motor on-threshold rise than no update, because first null has negative RPE and active motor targets receive depression
prediction.pass: all three candidate first rises delay at least 5000 us relative to no update, with a first DOWN and no silence/extra-action switching on first probe note; C1-C3 audits pass
prediction.fail: any candidate first rise advances at least 1000 us or first note becomes silent
prediction.inconclusive: no meaningful movement, mixed delayed/nonmoving cases, or qualitatively nonlinear action switch
prediction.legacy_reference: must reproduce prior full update probe exactly
prediction.no_reference: must reproduce prior no-update probe exactly

prohibitions: no ideal press time to sensory/motor
